summary: Planning-only split of I01e into two pending B1 children: reusable real HTTP catalog/art and SMTP mailbox synthetic adapters; test-only real-image/PostgreSQL Compose ownership, readiness/reset/retained-restart/evidence/cleanup tooling and integration isolation. I01e stays in-progress with every original outcome/check retained for combined qualification after both children. No runtime/build/UI/runner input changed or service/device/deployment started; no product scenario, independent review or release gate is claimed passed.
selectionReason: The clean master checkout exactly matches startCommit, is active/authorized under D-304 and has no findings or due capability reviews. I01a/I01b/I01c/I01d and their descendants are implemented. I01e is the earliest eligible pending task and all its explicit prerequisites are implemented. The real image/migration/health interfaces and original versioned fixtures exist, but the repository has no Compose file and :e2e is still a toolchain-only runner with no source/mailbox/reset services. Building and qualifying synthetic protocol adapters is a distinct bounded outcome from complete Compose lifecycle, reset quiescence and concurrent Testcontainers ownership. This pre-coding split retains both and the parent integration obligation instead of partially implementing an oversized unit or skipping to devices/accounts.

children.I01e1: Real synthetic-source HTTP and non-forwarding SMTP mailbox adapters: normal provider-shaped routes/origins/editions/art, harness-only inspection/fault/reset interfaces, isolation/readiness/retention/quiescence tests and local container qualification.
children.I01e2: Real application image/PostgreSQL/adapters Compose environment and explicit migration, complete ownership/readiness/reset/retained restart/evidence/cleanup commands, failed-setup refusal and simultaneous separate Testcontainers qualification.

planning.dependencies: I01e1 depends on implemented I01a/I01b; I01e2 depends on I01a/I01b/I01c/I01e1. Neither depends on its open parent or I01f. I01e preserves its original I01a/I01b/I01c prerequisites, outcome and checks; a later parent unit reruns combined documented provision/readiness/reset/failure/restart/isolation/cleanup qualification before closing it. I01f still requires completed I01e and I01d, and supplies actual normal-APK Android-to-service/source reachability, storage instrumentation and device/Appium adapter qualification. The original I01 parent checks all six foundation children before I02; no later task dependency changes.
planning.reviewBoundary: Both children inherit B1. Independent capability review stays after I01-I04 and all descendants, not after individual adapters or lifecycle children. B1 remains pending. Existing reviews/coverage/commit anchors, findings, authorization, runner/model/permissions and external release gates are unchanged.
coverage: I01e1 serves the existing I01b fixture bytes/metadata through ordinary HTTP, including compressed catalogs/checksums, printing/face images, missing/broken art and both identity-distinct datasets/editions. Origin rebinding uses fixture generation/validation and retained served-copy hashes, never application special-case IDs or a test-only parser. Version/outage controls are external infrastructure, not gameplay requests.

I01e1's mailbox receives actual SMTP without external delivery; its captured messages are inspectable only by harness administration. Test delivery probes qualify the adapter, not real reset-email generation or UI. Separate instance stores, empty/reset checks, restart retention and quiescing in-flight work establish the boundary I01e2 orchestrates. Do not add a mail sender/worker or SMTP requirement to the foundation service before I04.

I01e2 uses the actual I01c image, same-image explicit migration and normal schema/writer readiness, not a fake backend. It owns all mutable scenario resources, quiesces/stops old service/adapter work before reset and fails setup on any reset/readiness failure. Clean resets twice and failure-then-reset must prove empty implemented mutable stores/deliveries and a pinned synthetic baseline. Fresh foundation has only Flyway history/service_writer, not invented users/games/jobs.

Retained in-scenario service/DB/adapter restarts never perform independent-scenario reset. Preserve actual durable foundation data, selected fixture source and deliveries for that journey. Future account/session/deck/game/inbox/outbox/cache/notification stores and workers must join reset/readiness/cleanup when implemented; this child cannot claim their recovery or full T-551/T-662 coverage before those features exist.

Compose and Testcontainers own separate complete lifecycles/databases. I01e2 must run them together and reset/clean its exact Compose resources without touching Testcontainers or unrelated containers/networks/volumes/ports. Retain redacted failure evidence before cleanup; never global Docker pruning or production paths/credentials. Parent I01e repeats the combined outcome after both children, preserving all three original check obligations.

Only required service/source endpoints are configured for the device handoff; database/health/reset/mailbox administration are not normal client APIs or packaged product test routes. Exact WSL/Docker29 bridge/publication and device-facing origin behavior needs measured qualification, not assumptions based on the earlier internal-network image suite or browser smoke. I01f qualifies actual Android reachability, fresh app state and storage instrumentation without a dependency cycle.

No initialization helper is needed before account/deck features exist. Any later helper is restricted to validated users/saved decks before the scenario and cannot inject contacts/invitations/Ready/games/requests/history/actions or mutate them mid-journey. Reset is host-owned administration, never a gameplay API. Registration/import/reset/game acceptance still runs through the normal app/backend in owning tasks.

sourceIds.feedback: No F-specific UI is changed or implemented. All F01-F88 obligations and D-303 complete both-orientation mock comparison remain assigned to existing feature/B8 tasks. No UI-document edit/publication occurs.
sourceIds.accounting: T-551/T-630/T-662 retain their existing I01 foundation ownership; adapters/reset/Compose qualification cover only implemented infrastructure portions. Full normal-app reset/account/game/request/job/durable-worker/upgrade assertions remain pending in I01f and owning feature/I34/I35 work. T-625/T-626/T-629/T-659 need the future normal downloader/client behavior in I05; SMTP password-reset delivery/UI is I04. No ledger assertion or product scenario is marked executed by this planning unit.

limitations: This unit validates planning/state transitions, complete source coverage accounting and existing fixture integrity only. It does not build/execute adapters, Compose, SMTP, application images, tests with PostgreSQL, APKs or devices.

Implementing children must qualify concrete compatible adapter/container/Compose versions, target checks, actual readiness/quiescence and owned cleanup under current permissions. No guessed version matrix, new authority or permission grant is supplied by this split.

Only the ownership scheduler and singleton recovery exist in the service. Account/game/inbox/outbox/mail/push workers remain later tasks; this split does not label their absence a defect or fabricate ready/recovery passes. Physical frames I33, full Android/upgrade/mixed-version/architecture qualification I35 and all external gates stay open.
No subagent, new session, controller/loop, deployment or paid resource was started. The planning helper invokes only pure driver selection/state/transition functions, never constructing a driver.
